# Biological Databases and Knowledge Resources

## Learning Objectives

After reading this chapter, you should be able to:

- Explain the role of biological databases.
- Differentiate primary and secondary databases.
- Use databases to answer biological questions.

## Why This Matters

Imagine you have discovered a new gene associated with disease.

Where do you look first?

Modern biological discovery depends on databases.
